name: Augusta (United States)
description: Red field charged with a large blue letter A over a sunflower in yellow, orange and brown.
history: Augusta is a city in Butler County, Kansas. The flag was adopted in 2018 (the design by Jessica Dunegan won a public vote of 331 residents in December 2018, according to Flags of the World citing the Butler County Times-Gazette).

features.role: sunflower in yellow, orange and brown
